title: The Plan to Make American Crime Obsolete

reader_summary.headline: There's two things cops hate for things to change and for things to say the same.
reader_summary.overview: There's two things cops hate for things to change and for things to say the same. Most of the cops in the field are going to have to change the way their skill set is shaped. Because it's going to be a little bit more investigative.

key_points.text: It's going to be a little bit more nuanced.
key_points.evidence_quote: It's going to be a little bit more nuanced.

key_points.text: It's not going to look the same anymore.
key_points.evidence_quote: It's not going to look the same anymore.

key_points.text: Are people just going to start seeing drones flying around?
key_points.evidence_quote: Are people just going to start seeing drones flying around?

key_points.text: You hear a gunshot go off and the drone finds a shooter getting into a car and driving off and then pursuing the vehicle.
